env.name: AD_IMAGE_PROVIDER
env.description: Which image model actually generates: "openai" (default) or "google" (Nano Banana 2 / Nano Banana Pro). Only one provider's API key below is required, matching whichever you pick.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key — required when AD_IMAGE_PROVIDER=openai (the default).

env.name: OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL
env.description: Which OpenAI image model to call. Defaults to gpt-image-1 if unset.

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.description: Google AI Studio / Gemini API key — required when AD_IMAGE_PROVIDER=google.

env.name: GOOGLE_IMAGE_MODEL
env.description: Which Gemini image model to call when AD_IMAGE_PROVIDER=google: gemini-3.1-flash-image (Nano Banana 2, the default) or gemini-3-pro-image (Nano Banana Pro, higher quality and cost).

env.name: AD_IMAGE_OUTPUT_DIR
env.description: Where generated images are written on disk. Defaults to ./generated/ad-images if unset.
